_comment: Over-firing (false-positive) corpus for the dictionary-biasing regression gate. Every utterance is ordinary dictation that contains NO term from bench/dictionary-overfire.json, but DOES contain ordinary words acoustically near those terms (e.g. 'ran'/'grab'/'cram' ~ CRAN, 'sync'/'sink' ~ Snyk, 'ready'/'radish' ~ Redis, "Kate's"/'crates' ~ k8s, 'everything' ~ ultrathink, 'bonus'/'sonnet' ~ Sonnet Opus). The reference transcript is the correct text. Run through the biasing arm with dictionary-overfire.json: the CORRECT output equals the reference, so any dictionary term that appears is a false positive (an over-fire). Measured baseline (this generic dictionary, 3-voice set): FluidAudio 0.14.5 ~12 over-fires; 0.14.8 (the PR #634 regression) ~52. `terms: []` everywhere on purpose.
